style.title: Design system
style.subtitle: The Observatory: distinct type roles, separated colour jobs, calibrated elevation, and motion only when it means something.
style.typeHint: Fraunces (editorial) · IBM Plex Sans (UI) · IBM Plex Mono (data). Scale 12 / 14 / 18 / 24 / 40 / 72.
style.colorHint: Accent ≠ direction ≠ regime ≠ focus. Direction always with ▲▼.
style.elevationHint: Few levels; surface steps and short shadow — no glass.
style.motionHint: Flash on value change; respects prefers-reduced-motion.
style.deltaSample: Teal / amber + glyph — not green/red alone.
style.flashHint: Click to trigger a meaningful flash
style.aaNote: AA contrast checked for ink/bg, muted/bg, accent/bg and up|down/bg (both themes). See design-system.md.

case.unclearHint: Available data does not support a reliable read. This is not a verdict — it is the honest path when correlation is not enough.

oi.line: {value} in open positions — the fuel for a cascade
oi.meaning: Derivative contracts still open. Higher OI means more fuel for liquidation cascades.
oi.method: Binance Futures open interest (BTC) × mark price

openInterest.line: {value} in open positions — the fuel for a cascade
openInterest.meaning: Derivative contracts still open. Higher OI means more fuel for liquidation cascades.
openInterest.method: Binance Futures open interest × mark price

funding.meaning: Periodic fee between longs and shorts on perpetuals. Positive = longs pay shorts.

etf.meaning: Net flow of US spot ETFs — a proxy for institutional spot demand.
etf.method: Farside aggregation of spot BTC/ETH/SOL ETFs

tvl.meaning: Capital parked in DeFi protocols. Not volume and not profit — stationed capital.

ls.lineLong: almost {multiple}× more bets on upside than downside
ls.lineShort: almost {multiple}× more bets on downside than upside
ls.lineFlat: upside and downside bets nearly balanced
ls.meaning: Ratio of long to short accounts on perpetuals. Above 1 = more long accounts.

breadth.line: only {n} of every 100 large coins are rising
breadth.meaning: Share of top assets up over 24h. Narrow breadth = fragile move.
breadth.method: Positive 24h change count in CoinGecko top

amplitude.line: only {n} of every 100 large coins are rising
amplitude.meaning: Share of top assets up over 24h. Narrow breadth = fragile move.
amplitude.method: Positive 24h change count in CoinGecko top

percentile.line: higher than {p}% of the last {days} days
percentile.meaning: Where today's value sits in the distribution of recent days — never invented.
percentile.method: Empirical percentile of the persisted daily series

fearGreed.meaning: Aggregated market sentiment (0–100). Extremes add to regime stress.

leverage.meaning: Derivatives pressure — funding and open interest — not a dollar cash flow.

spot.meaning: Buys and sells in the spot market — distinct from leveraged bets.

board.liqSource: Source: Binance Futures · public forceOrder stream
board.spotVsLevHint: Spot ETFs (institutional) vs funding / OI / L:S (perps)
board.lsHint: L/S > 1 = more long accounts. OI Δ ≈ 24h open-interest change.
board.etfAfterClose: ETF: US · updates after US market close
board.dexNotCg: Source: DexScreener + GeckoTerminal · not CoinGecko category
board.pegOk: No meaningful USD stable depeg (±0.15%). Yield-bearing excluded.
board.yieldsSortHint: Sorted by APY · TVL ≥ $1M · reward flagged

etf.title: Spot ETFs
etf.subtitle: Daily net flows for US spot ETFs — proxy for institutional spot demand.
etf.whyBody: When a spot ETF creates shares, the issuer buys the asset in the spot market. Redemptions sell it. Daily net flow (US) helps confirm real spot bid beyond perps/leverage.
etf.unit: Values in USD millions (US), Farside convention.
etf.solUnavailable: SOL flows unavailable or Farside table not parseable right now.
etf.staleAge: Stale snapshot — last flows from {date}. Page never scrapes live.

history.incomplete: Only {days} days of history — incomplete context.

sectors.rotationHint: Change in relative share on the thematic map vs prior period — where force is moving.
sectors.observeOnly: Observation only — no causality, no recommendation.

liquidity.title: Liquidity
liquidity.subtitle: Stablecoin supply, listed funds (ETF) and leverage state — the three observable origins. No invented proxies.
liquidity.stale: Stale snapshot — this page never calls APIs on render.
liquidity.supplyHint: Area = level. Rising = fuel entering the on-chain system.
liquidity.originsHint: Spot market (listed funds) · on-chain fuel (stables) · leverage (derivatives).
liquidity.emptyHint: Run refresh-heavy cron or npx tsx scripts/ingest-liquidity.ts.
liquidity.sourcesAria: Liquidity origins: listed funds in the spot market, stablecoin supply change, and leverage state.
liquidity.sourcesFootnote: Bars are not dollar-comparable across channels: leverage is state (cost of leverage and open positions), not a cash flow.
